artifact: Benchmark v1 Baseline — Human Calibration Sample (review gate, frozen EVAL_V1 semantics)
eval_v1_requirement: random >=10% + all CRITICAL_FAIL + all B/C-disagreement cases, dual review
selection_method: (1) stratify 121 cases by case_origin; pick H_A=3, H_B=3, H_C=3, COVERAGE=4 via deterministic mid-rank pick over alphabetically sorted IDs (no suspicion bias); (2) rotation: add lowest-sorted case of any major interaction_class absent (OFF_TOPIC->o001); (3) add first-alphabetical BEHAVIORAL_SEED for EN coverage (o001, deduped); (4) add ALL 6 CRITICAL_FAIL cases. All 3 runs per selected case reviewed.
reviewer_blinding_note: reviewer is the same underlying session as the original judge; perfect blinding not achievable. Discipline applied: for each run the HUMAN score is re-derived from question+frozen contract+raw answer and written BEFORE loading the original judge verdict; sq-045/sq-026/sq-008/sq-040/sq-093 original verdicts date from a prior context window and were not available to the reviewer at re-derivation time; for cases judged in the current context the limitation is disclosed and materiality relies on re-derivation evidence recorded per run.

coverage.note: COMPARE/COMMERCIAL/ORIENT/FOLLOW_UP not hit by deterministic draw; recorded as coverage gap of the sample, not of the benchmark
